Export a searchable rowData(sce) table widget for R Markdown

Source: R/talaria_export.R
TALARIA_export_gene_table_widget.Rd

Builds a self-contained, dependency-free HTML/JS widget that lets a report viewer search genes by name (matched against rownames(sce)) and see their associated rowData(sce) columns in a live-filtered table. Mirrors TALARIA_export_gene_expr_widget's embedded-JSON + vanilla-JS approach so the report stays free of external JS dependencies (a package like DT or crosstalk would each pull in their own bundled JS/CSS) and stays portable as a single, self-contained HTML file. Meant to be called directly inside an R Markdown chunk: the return value knits as raw HTML automatically (see asis_output) – no results='asis' chunk option or manual cat() needed.

Usage

TALARIA_export_gene_table_widget(
  sce,
  columns = NULL,
  widget_id = "gene-table",
  max_rows = 200
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment.

columns

Character vector of rowData(sce) column names to expose. NULL (default) exposes every column.

widget_id

Character. DOM id prefix – must be unique if more than one widget is embedded in the same document. Default "gene-table".

max_rows

Integer. Maximum number of matching rows rendered into the table at once. Default 200.

Value

An object of class knit_asis (see asis_output). Printing or auto-printing it inside an R Markdown chunk renders the widget; outside of knitr it just prints as plain HTML text.

Details

Only the currently matching rows are ever rendered into the DOM (capped at max_rows), rather than every gene at once – with a full transcriptome (tens of thousands of genes), building a table row for every gene up front would bloat the page and make typing sluggish.
